structure Force (S : Table C.book) (U : Table C.book) (F : Contour S) (R : S.Rotation) (P : DiffPlan S)
    (H : S.RealSpin) (Q : Wightman S) (T : S.Stress) : Prop where
  appointment : ∃ (D : ∀ n, Blanket n) (Z : F.world.Aurora D), Prospect F.waves Z U P H T ∧ Gallery F.world Z
  orbital : ∀ (p : Poincare) (f : Test4) (a b : Axis) (x : Q.operators.domain), ∃ y : Q.operators.domain,
    Q.action.V p x.val=y.val ∧ Q.action.V p (fieldM Q T a b f x).val =
      ((∑ i : Axis, ∑ j : Axis, (((mat p.Λ i a * mat p.Λ j b : ℝ) : ℂ)) • fieldM Q T i j (Joint.push p f)) y).val
  symmetric : ∀ a b, fieldM Q T a b = fieldM Q T b a
  hermitian : ∀ (f : Test4) (a b : Axis) (u v : Q.operators.domain),
    inner ℂ (fieldM Q T a b f u).val v.val=inner ℂ u.val (fieldM Q T a b (Probe.bar f) v).val
  conserve : ∀ (b : Axis) (f : Test4), (∑ a : Axis, (eta a : ℂ) • fieldM Q T a b (partialProbe a f))=0
  commutator : Generates Q T R
  rule : Derives Q T R

proof_context.conclusion: `Force` records for the continued stress `fieldM Q T` the Lorentz action `orbital`, `symmetric`, `hermitian`, `conserve` on the word domain, and the charge law `commutator`.

theorem derivative_domain (P : DiffPlan S) (ht : T.Hierarchy) (hs : S.Symmetric)
    (hv : P.Inclusions S) (hu : P.Derivatives T) (hF : F.Region T) (hZ : Z.FullBody F)
    (hc : Bid.cones W) {Q : Wightman S} {R : S.Rotation} {h : S.RealSpin} (H : FieldCore W R h Q)
    (a : Axis) (d : ℕ) (t : S.Field d) (f : Test4) :
    Q.operators.field (S.pin (d+1) (P.deriv d a t)) f = Q.operators.field (S.pin d t) (probeAxis a f) := by
  refine on_domain H _ _ fun i j => ?_

proof_context.conclusion: `derivative_domain` gives `field (pin (d+1) (deriv d a t)) f = field (pin d t) (probeAxis a f)` on the word domain, the continued derivative identity with the Wick factor in `probeAxis`.

theorem conserves (F : Final C f S) (a : Axis) (t : Test4) :
    (∑ b : Axis, F.action.operators.field (S.pin 4 (F.sector.energy b a)) (probeAxis b t)) = 0 := by
  let P := F.action.operators

proof_context.conclusion: `conserves` gives the conservation identity `∑ b, field (pin 4 (energy b a)) (probeAxis b t) = 0` on the final action.
